data.gender_notes: Hit is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'hita', meaning 'to hit' or 'success'. In Hindu mythology, Hitas are celestial beings who bring prosperity and victory. The name is believed to bring good fortune and success in all endeavors. The name Hit carries the meaning “Success, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hit usually hope their child will grow to embody success, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the attainment of spiritual goals and inner victory.
data.etymology: Hit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Success, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hit total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
